name: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 3 ~Top o Nerae!~
original_name: 電脳学園３ ～トップをねらえ！～
source:
You, as an alpha-class Top, are supposed to win three keys to pilot the Great Gunbuster robot against the cosmic threat to humanity. The keys are held by Jung-Freud, Kazumi (oneesama) and Noriko, and you must retrieve the keys by defeating each character in a quiz game, which has the side-effect of stripping them of all their clothes.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cybernetic-hi-school-part-3-gunbuster]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
你是阿尔法班的顶尖学生，需要赢得3把钥匙，才能驾驶巨型钢巴斯塔迎战威胁人类的宇宙怪物。钥匙分别掌握在荣格·弗洛伊德、天野和美“姐姐”与高屋法子手中。你必须在问答游戏中逐一击败她们、夺取钥匙，而每场败北也会让她们身上的衣服一件件脱落，直至全裸。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cybernetic-hi-school-part-3-gunbuster]MobyGames[/url]]
